title: Chef Droid
description: Tasked with providing food for the master of the palace once ruled by Jabba the Hutt, the Chef Droid in the kitchens was ever alert for intruders. When he thought he heard a rat in the kitchen, Chef Droid dispatched his sous chef to find it and was startled to discover the bounty hunter Boba Fett and assassin Fennec Shand infiltrating his kitchen. With the knives in his hands, he began spinning his arms like weapons and moving in to attack Fett. But before the Droid could strike a blow, he found his head severed from his body by Fennec Shand.
